messages:
Luis (oncall): :rotating_light: Pager alert: multiple 5xxs from rate-limiter service. Spike started ~1763254300, hitting frontend -> rate-limiter -> rediscloud eu-west-1 path. Not self-healing.
PagerDuty: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-4821 (pager: Luis).
RedisCloudBot: We have detected degraded performance in cluster prod-euw-01. Elevated cmdlat/timeout counts. More details: https://status.redislabs.com/incidents/abc123 (vendor).
Maya R: Seeing a lot of client timeouts from token-check endpoints that rely on cached policy keys. Error sample: `GET /api/v1/check 504 (upstream timeout)` — logs show `i/o timeout` when contacting redis host.
Shaun Ops: Rate limiter is returning 429s and 503s intermittently. Traffic pattern: burst from a few high-QPS customers and internal CI jobs.
Luis (oncall): First mitigation: flip rate-limiter to degraded mode (allowlist heavy customers, raise default limit to 10r/s for unknown keys). I'll run the rollout now.
Luis (oncall): Command: ```kubectl -n infra set env deploy/ratelimiter RATE_LIMIT_MODE=degraded OVERRIDE_LIMIT=10```
DevEx Bot: Deploy job started: infra/ratelimiter @ k8s -> rollout 1/3 pods updated.
Shaun Ops: While that rolls, enable local in-memory fallback cache in token-service to avoid redis reads for 60s TTL. Maya, can you patch replica config?
Maya R: Patching token-service config: `TOKEN_CACHE_BACKEND=inmemory TTL=60` and restarting canaries. Patching now.
Alice PM: Customer impact FYI — internal monitors show ~3% of API calls returning 5xx overall, but certain customers are seeing up to 40% increase in errors. I've flagged Priority-Customers list.
SRE Rotation: Opening vendor escalation with Redis Cloud — ticket created with support level: P1, referencing cluster prod-euw-01. Vendor asked for connection diagnostics.
RedisCloudBot: Support ticket ID RC-78910 created; next update ETA 15m.
Luis (oncall): Temporary mitigation checklist: 1) degraded rate-limiter (done), 2) token-service local fallback (started), 3) throttle CI/ingress burst sources (in progress), 4) disable heavy non-essential endpoints (TBD).
Shaun Ops: Throttling CI jobs: added ingress rule to limit 'ci-bot' header to 20r/s. Confirming reduced burst.
Maya R: Token-service canary reported reduction in redis errors post-fallback, 10% error -> 2% on canary. Rolling to remaining replicas.
DevEx Bot: Rollout completed: infra/ratelimiter -> 3/3 pods.
Luis (oncall): Next: prepare traffic shaping for top 5 noisy keys. Run query to identify top keys: `SELECT key, count(*) FROM ratelimiter.logs WHERE ts > now() - 5m GROUP BY key ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 5;`
Shaun Ops: Top keys identified: api_key:ci-internal, api_key:loadtest, api_key:partner-27. Notifying partner-27 via support channel.
Alice PM: Customer comms draft: "We're investigating transient errors impacting rate limiting and auth checks in EU. Mitigations in place; no persistent data loss expected. Will send update in 30m." Approve? :eyes:
SRE Rotation: Approve, send and include temporary workaround steps for engineers (use retry backoff, avoid large burst jobs).
Luis (oncall): Vendor update: Redis Cloud reports `networked eviction` and `io_retries` elevated; they are performing node failover for shard 2. ETA 12m.
Shaun Ops: Given failover, we should prepare to drain connections gracefully. Increasing client side connection timeout and enable retry-on-read errors: `redis.client.timeout=5s retry=3`
Maya R: Rolling those config flags now via configmap; applying to staging then prod.
DevEx Bot: Config update deployed to token-service canaries.
Luis (oncall): Handoff note: I'm scheduled to go offline at +30m. @SRE Rotation please take over if this persists. Current status: degraded mode active, token-service fallback rolled to prod, vendor failover in progress.
SRE Rotation: Taking over. I'll coordinate next vendor update and patch rate-limiter hysteresis if we see oscillation.
RedisCloudBot: Incident RC-78910 update: shard failover completed, client reconnects expected. Some residual latency for 5-10m.
Shaun Ops: Seeing reduction in 5xxs. Metric: error-rate for rate-limiter now 0.8% (from peak 4.1%).
Alice PM: Sending 30m customer update now.
Luis (oncall): Final checklist before closing: 1) verify no customer-facing 5xxs >1% for 15m, 2) postmortem ticket created, 3) vendor root cause and SLA credit requested.
SRE Rotation: I'll keep thread open until 60m stable window. Starting postmortem doc stub: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5231
Alice PM: Good job team. Follow-ups: evaluate secondary cache for auth caches, make rate-limiter knob more dynamic per-customer, and improve vendor playbook. :thumbsup:
Luis (oncall): Closing handoff. Off to brief.
RedisCloudBot: Final vendor note: monitoring OK; case remains open for RCA.
SRE Rotation: Marking incident as 'mitigated' in PagerDuty, will continue monitoring.
PagerDuty: Incident INC-2026-0315-4821 status changed to Mitigated.
